# Worked example

This directory contains the complete bundled example used by
`VoroGaze::run_vorogaze()`:

- `fixrep_demo_synthetic.csv` – 20 deterministic synthetic fixation rows for
  two invented participants, dedicated under CC0 1.0; and
- `faces/001_03.jpg` – one 350 × 466 pixel image from the Face Research Lab
  London Set, redistributed unchanged under CC BY 4.0.

The CSV coordinates use a 1600 × 900 screen with the image centred at
`(800, 450)`. The image and its attribution are described in the repository's
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
